title: SOFA and qSOFA: Sepsis Risk Assessment Concepts
subject: Clinical Scoring Systems
preview: SOFA summarizes organ dysfunction across respiratory, coagulation, liver, cardiovascular, neurologic and renal systems.
quickRevision: SOFA summarizes organ dysfunction across respiratory, coagulation, liver, cardiovascular, neurologic and renal systems.
Sepsis identification rests on suspected infection with acute organ dysfunction rather than an isolated score.
Trending organ function after treatment can help assess illness trajectory.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: SOFA summarizes organ dysfunction across respiratory, coagulation, liver, cardiovascular, neurologic and renal systems.
qSOFA is a bedside risk prompt, not a sufficiently sensitive stand-alone sepsis screening or diagnostic test.
